text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost. ＜Blocker＞

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] By trashing 1 of this Digimon's link cards, ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon until your opponent's turn ends.
